rubric.notes: A positive query passes when a returned candidate has at least 30 fixed world points and projects into the approximate target reference boxes in at least two held-out views (centroid inside and bbox IoU >= 0.25), with at least two training-source evidence views. Multiple physically separate instances must be exposed as candidates. Source evidence must be visually verified. Evaluation uses project-specific reference boxes independent of the semantic detector; it is a small acceptance sample, not an independent human benchmark. Thresholds are frozen before final query execution; no tuning against final outcomes.

geometry_rubric.heldout_inspection: Inspect at least three held-out view comparisons and disclose holes, duplicates and color artifacts.
